stem.text: The diagram shows the structure of progesterone.

stem.alt: Skeletal formula of progesterone: four fused rings (three six-membered and one five-membered) with a C=O group on the left ring, a C=C in the left ring, a C=O group on the five-membered ring with a CH3 group, and two angular CH3 groups.
stem.label: progesterone

stem.text: Which statement about progesterone is correct?

A.text: One molecule contains four chiral carbon atoms only; the molecular formula is $\text{C}_{19}\text{H}_{26}\text{O}_2$.

B.text: One molecule contains four chiral carbon atoms only; the molecular formula is $\text{C}_{21}\text{H}_{30}\text{O}_2$.

C.text: One molecule contains six chiral carbon atoms; the molecular formula is $\text{C}_{19}\text{H}_{26}\text{O}_2$.

D.text: One molecule contains six chiral carbon atoms; the molecular formula is $\text{C}_{21}\text{H}_{30}\text{O}_2$.
